chapter: George Lewis and the 1946 Jazz Foundation concert
title: The concert night: Bunk Johnson, Happy Goldstein as grand marshal, and the photo
summary: Williams says Bunk played that night while Kid Howard did the advertising, that Happy Goldstein led the band on stage as grand marshal, and they look at the photos.
